## description:

_Created on Minecraft version 1.21.6._
A multiplayer-friendly datapack that adds a custom totem allowing players to come back to life in Hardcore mode. Requires another player to perform the resurrection — one last chance to cheat death and continue the adventure together!
### What it adds:
- A new crafting recipe for the Totem of Resurrection
- Indestructible armor stands that appear at the location of a player's death
- The ability to resurrect a dead player (if they're still on the server) by throwing the totem at their armor stand
- A "Resurrection" advancement granted upon returning to life
